meta.title: Gems Hunter — Handmade silver jewelry & natural raw stones
meta.description: Every stone is a story. Gems Hunter makes handmade silver jewelry from natural stones and keeps raw crystals and specimens. Hanoi and Ho Chi Minh City, Vietnam.
meta.og_title: Gems Hunter — Find the stone that finds you.
meta.og_description: Every stone is a story. Handmade silver jewelry in aquamarine, moonstone, opal, plus raw crystals and specimens. Hanoi and Ho Chi Minh City.
meta.ld_description: Handmade silver jewelry from natural stones, plus raw crystals and specimens.

home.kicker: Gems Hunter · silver jewelry & natural raw stones
home.lede: Each piece is a single natural stone, left raw or lightly polished, then wrapped in silver and knotted by hand. Beside the jewelry, we keep raw crystals and specimens to display and to treasure.
home.alt_aqua_macrame: Raw aquamarine wand in a macramé net
home.alt_citrine_pendant: Citrine pendant on a silver chain
home.statement: We look for stones that still carry the shape of the earth, then lay them on an open page, so every piece of jewelry has a story of its own.
home.alt_aqua_book: Aquamarine necklace resting on a book page
home.ch_p: Our collections arrive album by album, each one a story. Pieces that have found their owner are marked; message us to hold any of the others.
home.ch1_alt: Raw aquamarine necklace on a book page
home.ch1_p: A whole aquamarine wand on a silver bail, blue as shallow sea water.
home.ch2_p: A moonstone heart with a blue sheen, like the moon on a still lake.
home.ch3_alt: Black opal pendant with green flash
home.ch3_p: Green fire like snake scales inside a black opal, set in plain silver.
home.ch4_p: A clear drop of rose quartz, shot in late sun among dried flowers.
home.ch5_p: A cabochon opal with enough fire to become the pendant you imagine.
home.pk_sub: Pick a stone to see it raw, and again once it has become jewelry in our hands.
home.hu_p: Raw gems, authentic value. Crystal clusters, agate slices, amethyst geodes, kept just as the earth made them: to display, to keep, or for us to turn into jewelry.
home.alt_h_ringbox: Ring box carved from an agate geode
home.pr1_alt: Raw stones on a wooden table among plants
home.pr1_p: We choose each natural stone by hand and keep only the ones with the most beautiful shape and colour.
home.pr2_p: Each stone gets a bail, a silver wire wrap or a macramé net, following its own shape.
home.pr3_alt: Moonstone pendant in a straw-paper box
home.pr3_p: Your piece is packed in a straw-paper box and sent off. Pay by bank transfer, or cash on delivery with a 50% deposit.
home.ab_p: A small shop run by people who love stones. We hunt for natural stones that still hold the shape of the earth: some stay raw to be displayed, others are wrapped in silver and knotted into jewelry. Made with love.
home.cta_after: Jewelry or raw stones, it's all one place. Orders are made by Instagram message.

picker.say: March's birthstone, blue as shallow sea water. We keep its long wand shape when setting it on a ring.
From a deep purple crystal cave to a string of clear round beads, laid on a book page as we always do.
Citrine's honey colour: speckled like sugar when raw, catching light on every facet once cut.
Clear as water. Some beads still hold tiny green inclusions, a trace that belongs to each one alone.
We choose each opal by its fire. You pick the stone, we shape the pendant around it.
